import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a photo record and return its id."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitive."""
    term_lower = term.lower()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE ? OR LOWER(description) LIKE ? ORDER BY id ASC",
        (f"%{term_lower}%", f"%{term_lower}%")
    )
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo to S3, returning the object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Photo exceeds 5 MiB size limit")
    
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", filename.split("/")[-1])
    key = f"photos/{uuid.uuid4().hex}/{safe_name}"
    
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not isinstance(expires, int) or expires < 1 or expires > 3600:
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    url = s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )
    return url


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
        return photo_id
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)

            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, description: str, s3_key: str) -> int:

        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    search_term = f"%{term}%"
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (search_term, search_term)
    )
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket: str, filename: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo, returning its S3 key."""
    # Validate content type
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")

    max_size = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    if len(data) > max_size:
        raise ValueError(f"File size exceeds maximum of {max_size} bytes")
    
    # Extract safe filename (base name only, no directory components)
    basename = filename.split("/")[-1].split("\\")[-1]
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", basename)
    
    # Generate key with uuid4
    photo_uuid = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{photo_uuid}/{safe_name}"
    
    # Upload to S3
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket: str, key: str, expires: int = 3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn: sqlite3.Connection, s3, bucket: str, title: str, description: str, filename: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> int:

    try:

This module contains no AWS credentials and never constructs AWS clients;
the S3 client and the database connection are provided by the caller.
"""

import os

    """Create the photos table if it does not already exist."""
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        """

            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
        """
    )

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:

    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    """Insert a photo metadata row and return its new id."""
    uploaded_at = _utc_now_iso()

        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",

    new_id = cur.lastrowid
    if new_id is None:

        new_id = cur.fetchone()[0]

    """Convert a DB row (tuple-like or mapping-like) into a plain dict."""
    if hasattr(row, "keys"):

    return dict(zip(_COLUMNS, row))


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list:

    Search photos by title/description, matching rows whose title or
    description contains `term` as a literal substring, case-insensitively.

    return results

def _rollback_quietly(conn) -> None:
    try:

    except Exception:

def init_db(conn) -> None:

    cur = conn.cursor()
    try:

            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos ("

            "description TEXT, "
            "s3_key TEXT NOT NULL, "
            "uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL"
            ")"
        )
        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        _rollback_quietly(conn)
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            cur.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    """Insert one photo row using bound parameters and return its id."""
    uploaded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    cur = conn.cursor()

        )

        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        _rollback_quietly(conn)
        raise

            "FROM photos ORDER BY id ASC"
        )
        rows = cur.fetchall()
    finally:

            cur.close()
        except Exception:

    for row in rows:
        record = dict(zip(_COLUMNS, tuple(row)))
        title = record["title"] or ""
        description = record["description"] or ""
        if needle in str(title).casefold() or needle in str(description).casefold():

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing (no route to the internet gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier - HTTP and HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from administrator CIDR only.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
          Description: SSH from administrator CIDR only
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database tier - MySQL only from the web security group.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web tier only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier: launch template, instance and Elastic IP
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            yum install -y httpd php
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl start httpd
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn:
      - InternetGatewayAttachment
      - PublicDefaultRoute
      - PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  WebServerElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-eip"

  WebServerElasticIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt WebServerElasticIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier: DB subnet group and RDS MySQL instance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the MySQL database.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-group"

  DatabaseInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: "8.0"
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mysql"

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website (Elastic IP of the web server).
    Value: !Sub "http://${WebServerElasticIP}"

  DatabaseEndpointAddress:
    Description: Endpoint address of the RDS MySQL instance (reachable only from the web tier).
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseInstance.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Photo-sharing website stage 2 - custom VPC, public/private subnets, web server from launch template with Elastic IP, and encrypted private RDS MySQL.

Parameters:

    Description: ID of the custom AMI used for the web server (must exist in this Region).

    Default: admin
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumerics or underscores.

Resources:
  # ---------------- Networking ----------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16

        - Key: Name

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

    Properties:

    Properties:

    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------- Security groups ----------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web server security group - HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from administrator CIDR only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database security group - MySQL only from the web security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:

        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash -xe
            if command -v amazon-linux-extras >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              amazon-linux-extras install -y php8.2 || true
            fi
            yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd || yum install -y httpd php
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl start httpd

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-eip'

  WebElasticIPAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt WebElasticIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance

  # ---------------- Database tier ----------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the MySQL database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-group'

    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageEncrypted: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !GetAtt DBSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mysql'

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the website (static Elastic IP)
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebElasticIP}'
  DatabaseEndpointAddress:

    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  PhotoBucket:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject

  WebServerInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------- Load balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:

      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200-399'
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward

    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebServerAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebServerInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'

  WebServerAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute1
      - PrivateDefaultRoute2
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
      - HttpListener
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '2'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true
    UpdatePolicy:
      AutoScalingRollingUpdate:
        MinInstancesInService: 1
        MaxBatchSize: 1
        PauseTime: PT5M

  CpuScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebServerAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      EstimatedInstanceWarmup: 300
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 50

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp2
      MultiAZ: true
      StorageEncrypted: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- CloudFront
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub 'Photo-sharing website (${AWS::StackName})'
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # AWS managed policies: CachingDisabled and AllViewer
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name (use https://)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
  PhotoBucketName:
    Description: Name of the private S3 bucket that stores uploaded photos
    Value: !Ref PhotoBucket
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL database
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address
  DatabaseMasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the database master password
    Value: !GetAtt Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 Photo-sharing Website - Secure, Scalable, Highly Available Deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for web tier instances
  DatabaseMasterPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master password for RDS MySQL (will be stored in Secrets Manager)
    MinLength: 8

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: "Instance Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - CustomAMIId
      - Label:
          default: "Database Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - DatabaseMasterPassword

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  PhotoVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoIGW

  AttachIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGatewayEIP

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGateway

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LoadBalancerSG

  WebInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier instances
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceSG

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DatabaseSG

  # Application Load Balancer
  PhotoLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-alb-${AWS::StackName}'
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoLoadBalancer

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-tg-${AWS::StackName}'
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoTargetGroup

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PhotoLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceRole

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoBucket

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'photo-lt-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: PhotoWebInstance

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'photo-asg-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoWebInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS Database Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'photo-db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Photo RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDBSubnetGroup

  # Secrets Manager Secret for RDS Password
  RDSMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'rds/photo/${AWS::StackName}/master'
      SecretString: !Sub |
        {
          "username": "admin",
          "password": "${DatabaseMasterPassword}"
        }

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${RDSMasterSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

  # CloudFront Distribution
  PhotoCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
        CacheBehaviors:
          - PathPattern: /health
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            CachedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            Compress: true
            ForwardedValues:
              QueryString: false
            TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: allow-all
            DefaultTTL: 0
            MaxTTL: 0
            MinTTL: 0
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        Logging:
          Bucket: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.DomainName
          Prefix: cloudfront-logs/
          IncludeCookies: false

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomainName'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNSName'

Description: 'Stage 3 - Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Stage 3 (Quadrant C) photo-sharing website: secure, scalable, highly available
  deployment with VPC, ALB, Auto Scaling web tier in private subnets, S3 photo
  bucket, RDS MySQL Multi-AZ, and CloudFront in front of the load balancer.

Parameters:
  WebAmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for the web instances (must be in this Region).

  DBUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,15}"
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters (max 16).
    Description: Master username for the RDS instance. The password is managed by Secrets Manager.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEipAddress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAddress.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP from the internet to the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg"

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP only from the load balancer security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from the load balancer only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web tier only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Load Balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 photo bucket (no fixed name; Block Public Access fully enabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-photos"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role and instance profile for web instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Join ["", [!GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn, "/*"]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-role"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch template and Auto Scaling group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-volume"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn: PrivateDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-asg"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuTargetTrackingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS MySQL (Multi-AZ, private, encrypted, managed master password)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets"

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distribution in front of the load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing distribution"
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # Managed "CachingDisabled" policy (dynamic site content)
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          # Managed "AllViewer" origin request policy
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution (HTTPS entry point)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
```

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP from the internet to the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg"

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP to web instances only from the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Load Balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier: IAM, launch template, Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      TagSpecifications:
        - ResourceType: instance
          Tags:
            - Key: Name
              Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-asg"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuTargetTrackingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Photo storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-site database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing site"
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # Managed "CachingDisabled" and "AllViewer" origin request policy
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC

      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachIGW

      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoLoadBalancer

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-tg-${AWS::StackName}'

      Protocol: HTTP

      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP

      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5

        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoTargetGroup

        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceRole

    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

          - Effect: Allow

              - s3:GetObject

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:

      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoBucket

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'photo-lt-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: PhotoWebInstance

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'photo-asg-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoWebInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS Database Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'photo-db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Photo RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDBSubnetGroup

  # Secrets Manager Secret for RDS Password
  RDSMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'rds/photo/${AWS::StackName}/master'
      SecretString: !Sub |
        {
          "username": "admin",
          "password": "${DatabaseMasterPassword}"
        }

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${RDSMasterSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

  # CloudFront Distribution
  PhotoCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
        CacheBehaviors:
          - PathPattern: /health
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            CachedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            Compress: true
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: allow-all
            ForwardedValues:
              QueryString: false
            TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DefaultTTL: 0
            MaxTTL: 0
            MinTTL: 0
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        Logging:
          Bucket: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.DomainName
          Prefix: cloudfront-logs/
          IncludeCookies: false

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomainName'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNSName'

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

    Properties:

    Properties:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from the load balancer only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # Load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        - !Ref PublicSubnet2

        - Key: Name

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-photos"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compute: launch template and Auto Scaling group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuTargetTrackingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo database.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CDN
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo site"
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name.
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24

        - Key: Name

      HealthCheckEnabled: true

      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  # CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB

  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub 'Photo-sharing site distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:

            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # AWS managed policy: CachingDisabled
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          # AWS managed policy: AllViewer
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
  PhotoBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for uploaded photos
    Value: !Ref PhotoBucket
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the RDS MySQL instance
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address
  DatabaseMasterSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the database master password
    Value: !GetAtt Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
